title: List Page - Verify and check search functionality on Column Configuration – List Page.
preconditions:
1.URL must be working
2.user should be on FMS home page

steps.action: Go to Extraction & Load Layer -> Column Configuration
steps.expectedResult: User should redirect to the list page
Search panel should be open

steps.action: Try to filter data data based on the field and click on the search button
steps.expectedResult: Data should be filter out based on the field.
Search field parameter field should be removed.
Search panel should be close.
Filtered data should be removed.
